# Supply dump capacity

Used in [Trucks and dumps](/rules/logistics/40-trucks-and-dumps).

## Table

| Location | Ammo | Fuel | Stores | Water |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| tunis tripoli box | unlimited | unlimited | unlimited | unlimited |
| major city | unlimited | unlimited | unlimited | unlimited |
| village | 2500 | 8000 | 3000 | 1000 |
| other terrain | 1500 | 5000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| non dump | 50 | 0 | 50 | 0 |

## Notes

- Supply Dump Capacity Chart: the most Supply Points of each type that may be kept in one dump by location; 'non-dump' is the most that may lie in a hex with no dump. The rules text calls it 54.13, the chart sheet heads it 54.12
- The Tunis/Tripoli row covers each of the four Axis off-map boxes of the Tripoli–Tunis region. The chart's key adds that water may be drawn as well as stored in a village, major city or Tunis/Tripoli box, and that the Tunis/Tripoli/In Transit boxes may not be used as supply dumps (ruling R-073: the Tunis/Tripoli row is an unlimited storage allowance, not a dump)
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 108) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p14): 0 of 20 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
